note: Refreshed origin-based (deploy-honest) anchor after the xP zero-round mask, requested post-merge. Masked run scores 1906. Regenerating the pre-mask predictions (preds_origin_gw153_183_retuned.csv, unchanged since 2026-07-11) through today's MILP reproduces 1903, not the originally-logged 1916 - a 13pt drift attributed to MILP tie-break noise from the same-day CBC->HiGHS default swap (both solvers prove optimality on tied objectives but can pick different equal-value squads); not a regression. Paired comparison on the regenerated pair: 1903 vs 1906, CI [-135,+151], sign test 10-15 (6 ties) p=0.424 - a clear tie, same verdict as the standard protocol (2086 vs 2060). New origin-based anchor: 1906 (supersedes 1916).

Direct test of the 'MILP consumes within-GW ranking' hypothesis (audit C3): optimizing NDCG on rank labels loses points even with an isotonic points-scale map - the level/tail information a regressor keeps evidently matters to squad value beyond ordering. Hypothesis weakened; member kept in registry, not merged to main.
